name: Temporary Residence for Family Reunification

requirement_groups.name: Immediate family member of a Macedonian citizen or resident

requirements.blocker_text: Immediate family members of North Macedonian citizens (and, per Invest North Macedonia's own listing of temporary-residence purposes, family members of resident foreigners more broadly) qualify for temporary residence on reunification grounds. Under 2025 amendments, family-of-citizen applicants are exempted from the financial-means and health-insurance requirements otherwise applied to other temporary-residence categories. Temporary residence for this purpose is typically granted for around 1 year, renewable, converting to permanent residence after 5 continuous years on temporary status.
requirements.fix_path: Apply for temporary residence as the immediate family member of a Macedonian citizen or lawfully resident foreigner.

evidence_required.document: Marriage certificate or proof of filiation
Criminal record certificate (country of residence, within 12 months)

sources.title: Lawyers Antevski (law firm) -- kinds of residence permits in North Macedonia including family reunification, and the 5-year continuous-temporary-residence rule for permanent residence
Invest North Macedonia (government investment-promotion agency) -- lists family reunification among the recognized purposes for temporary residence
